A monopoly (from Greek monos μόνος (alone or single) + polein πωλεῖν (to sell)) exists when a specific person or enterprise is the only supplier of a particular commodity.
Monopoly is a roll-and-move game where players move around the game board buying or trading properties, developing their properties with houses and hotels. When opponents land on players owned property, the owning player collects rent from the landing player. Owning sets of properties increases the rent paid to the player who owns them, by the player who lands on the square. The ultimate goal is to have the most money and drive opponents into bankruptcy.

It’s been 10 years since the Animaccord team started the production of the Marsha and the Bear cartoon. The series, which today, without any overstatement, has been a worldwide YouTube phenomenon that has conquered the hearts of billions of kids and their parents throughout the world. This special board game is created and issued to mark the 10th anniversary of Animaccord Studio’s establishment. Step by step, you will pass through all stages of production of an animated series – starting with script writing all the way to the first episode releasing on air. Will you be able to sell the brand’s licensing for the creation of consumer products? Are you ready to be at the top of your industry and get international success? The game vividly shows all the obstacles that the Animaccord studio has handled over the last 10 years. Feels like a challenge? Of course! But, we believe that you will accomplish this mission and find success with your beloved heroes. item.description:
This edition of Monopoly was produced for the Ariel Investments company. The token are a tortoise (the symbol of the firm), a sleeping hare, a bull, a bear, a dollar sign and a loving cup. The money,title deeds, Chance and Community Chest cards are customized. All the title deeds are named for Ariel properties. Stock exchanges replace the railroad spaces. The Chance and Community Chest cards are renamed Fork In The Road and Ariel Community Academy.
Players roll dice to determine how far they move. Landing on a space gives the player the option of buying the property. When a player collects all the properties in one color group, the properties can be improved by building. When players land on a space owned by another player they must pay rent. Rent is determined by the location of the property and the number of improvements on the space. Some spaces instruct a player to draw a card which can be beneficial or harmful to the player. Players must avoid going bankrupt to stay in the game. The winner is the last player left in the game.

item.description:
Whereas the hat, car, iron, and other token pieces represent players in the normal version of Monopoly, Monopoly: Assassin's Creed lets you choose between the series' different protagonists. You can play as Altair, Ezio, Connor Kenway, his grandfather Edward Kenway, Aveline, or the protagonist of Assassin's Creed Unity, Arno Dorian.
Other game pieces have also be changed to match the Assassin's Creed theme. Money has been replaced with Abstergo credits, and the usual real estate is swapped out for historical locations featured in the Assassin's Creed series, with Abstergo Industries and Abstergo Entertainment replacing the game's original prime properties: Boardwalk and Park Place.
